research_question: Can sparse source-addressed correction still help when prior B errors are mixed, A has two prior updates per cue, and late B revision is incomplete or contains one wrong label?

task.training_order: SHA-256 rank of namespace|order|seed|original row index, inherited from pinned selector and audited independently.
task.private_maps: Independent balanced binary A and B cue maps; global target is A target XOR B target.
task.initial_B_map: Rank B cues by SHA-256 of namespace|initial_wrong|seed|B cue; invert the first four true B targets and retain the other four. Selection is target- and outcome-blind.
task.early_A_updates: During training, retain the first two encountered events for each A cue. For each selected event, emit one B-interpreted packet under the mixed initial B map and apply one signed update to its active A branch. Exactly 16 early A updates and 16 source-matched anchors are required; other training events do not update A.
task.late_revision_time: After all 512 training episodes, before 16 replay ticks.

revision_conditions.full: All eight B cues receive exact target revision events.
revision_conditions.partial_six: Rank B cues by SHA-256 of namespace|revision_visible|seed|B cue; the first six receive exact target revision events, while two retain their initial local code.
revision_conditions.one_corrupt: All eight B cues receive revision events, but the first cue ranked by SHA-256 of namespace|revision_corrupt|seed|B cue is flipped; other seven are exact.

packet_contract.A_anchor: Source ID, A cue, active branch and prior signed update; at most 16 entries.
packet_contract.B_anchor: Same source ID, B cue, B action, global success and prior signed packet; at most 16 entries.
packet_contract.replay: One source-keyed lookup per tick for 16 ticks. Reinterpret the outcome under the revised B-local code. Emit one 21-byte packet only if revised sign differs from stored prior sign; otherwise leave the previous A update unchanged.
packet_contract.simple_replay: For each changed sign, apply one revised signed local step; an old wrong update may only be cancelled.
packet_contract.correction_packet: For each changed sign, magnitude_bucket=2 permits exactly two revised signed local steps on the recorded branch, reversing and replacing one prior update. Never update an unrecorded branch.
